messages:
alex: FYI — customer reported 415 when trying to stream to our rerank endpoint. Copy of their client below. Request id: req-0a1b2c, customer: acme-corp. They used EventSource / text/event-stream.

alex: Customer's client (redacted):
```
const es = new EventSource('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank', { headers: { 'Content-Type': 'text/event-stream', 'Authorization': 'Bearer sk-...'} });
```

alex: Server response (snippet):
```
HTTP/1.1 415 Unsupported Media Type
content-type: application/json
body: {"error":"unsupported content-type"}
```

ingrid: Rerank endpoint does not support SSE/streaming. It expects a single POST application/json payload with the items to rerank. 415 happens because we check Content-Type and reject anything other than application/json.

maria: Can repro locally with curl sending chunked SSE content. Repro steps:
1) run curl with -H "Content-Type: text/event-stream" -d @payload.json
2) see 415 + logs: "rejected content-type"

ingrid: Workarounds: tell customer to POST with application/json like:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"query":"Which is better?","candidates": ["A","B","C"]}'
```
We should also add note in docs clarifying that rerank is non-streaming.

alex: Customer also mentioned retries caused unexpected token usage/cost. They retried full payload a few times. I'll flag billing and suggest they use idempotency keys and shorter retries.

ingrid: I'll open an internal bug to improve 415 message to say "text/event-stream not supported — use application/json POST to /v1/rerank" and link to docs. Assign to simon. Also add a check so we log the incoming content-type and request-id in the error response.

support-bot: Ticket SR-12345 created by alex (linked to req-0a1b2c)

simon: Thanks — on it. Quick fix to error message + docs update should be small; will push a patch to runtime today.

alex: cc @maria — can you confirm there were no infra-level errors or latency spikes? The customer also reported slower responses earlier.

maria: Checked logs — no latency anomalies for that tenant during the window. The 415s are immediate rejects. No sign of throttles. :white_check_mark:

alex: I'll reply to customer with repro steps, workaround, and SR number. Closing loop unless eng wants more.

ingrid: Please keep the thread if they escalate. I'll add a unit test for content-type handling.
